summary: Defined the no-maintainer-script activation rule for AgentOS ecosystem artifacts.
acceptance_evidence: Artifact manifests cannot define arbitrary shell hooks or traditional pre/post install scripts.
Activation operations are typed semantic operations and policy evaluated.
aom activate remains a previewable AgentCore PlanSpec path.
SecurityExecutionEngine owns exact approval, sandbox policy, EffectPrepared and CommitSealed.
Package manager adapters remain isolated workflows, not trusted maintainer scripts.

commands.summary: Replay passed and kept activation prepared=false before approved SecurityExecution.

blocked_shortcuts: No maintainer-script authority copied from OS package managers.
promotion_impact: Artifact activation stays typed, replayable and mediated by AgentCore plus SecurityExecution.
